responses.fb_other: So, this has actually been one of my favorite tasks probably. My ONLY issue that made me stop a bit early is the original instructions weren't very clear with examples of what a "false" peak is, and the UI on some doesn't help. Eg I'd have to zoom in-out multiple times just to see "all" the ups/downs but it made it insanely hard to tell if eg small ones comparatively were real/false peaks. Otherwise super fun task, thanks!
